title: build probes: the dangling seed-reference fix names a repair that does nothing under the default seed mode, and two seeds of one object are judged as one
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## Why

PR #35244 (cards #34776 and #35146) adds the build probes `seed_reference_unresolved` and `rollup_never_computed`. Its last contract review (PR comment 6995403690, head `812290548f`) passed with two should-fix points and three nits open. They are carried here so the PR could land.

Who acts: the server lane (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`, `build-probes.user-text.ts`). Reader: an author, or an AI client, right after a build.

## Evidence

- **Repair text under `ignore` (should-fix).** The finding's `fix` and its 11 `userMessage` texts say to correct the seed and republish. Under the default seed mode `ignore`, the replay leaves the rows it created earlier as they are, so the stored value still names no row. Those rows are now in `landed.matched`, which the probe does not read under `ignore`, so the next receipt comes back clean with nothing repaired.
- **Two seeds of one object (should-fix).** `seedApplied.landed` merges every seed of an object into one `matched` list. With seed A (`ignore`) and seed B (`upsert`) on the same object, a row only A matched is read and judged under B's rule. Each seed also emits its own finding over the same rows, so one dangling value is reported once per seed.
- Same family: under `upsert` or `update`, a matched row's column the seed does not write (`applyOn: 'create'`, or a column the records do not carry) is reported, and `fix` says to correct it in the seed, which does not reach it.
- Nits: the roll-up `message` says "of one organization" on every path, including the pass that is not split by organization; the roll-up `userMessage` (11 locales), the changeset and the PR table say blank on "every" parent while the verdict is one organization's sampled parents; the organization discovery samples 50 child rows where a distinct read could push down, and the code gives no reason.

## Scope

- `fix` and `userMessage` name the repair that works for the seed's mode: correct or delete the stored rows, or declare `upsert`.
- Read `matched` only when every published seed of the object declares a writing mode; emit one finding per object and column.
- Skip, or word for, a matched row's column the seed does not write.
- Fix the three nit texts, or state the reason for the sample.

## Done when

- A republish under `ignore` after a dangling reference either repairs it or keeps reporting it with a repair that works.
- Two seeds of one object, one `ignore` and one `upsert`, yield one finding per object and column, judged only on rows a writing seed landed.

## Relations

- Origin: contract review 6995403690 on PR #35244; L1 delta ACCEPT 6995388753.
- Related: #34776, #35146, #35251, #35256.

Re-check: `git grep -n "seed_reference_unresolved" origin/main -- packages/metadata-protocol/src`
